name: Prone Flutter Kick
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended straight behind you and rest your forehead comfortably on your stacked hands.
Brace your abs lightly, squeeze your glutes, and lift both straight legs a few inches off the floor.
Raise one leg slightly higher while lowering the other toward the floor without touching down.
Continue alternating legs in smooth, steady kicks while keeping your hips pressed lightly into the ground.
tips: Keep the kicks modest in height so your glutes and lower back stay engaged without pinching your spine.
Extend from your hips with straight knees rather than flapping only from the knees down.
